columns.name: num_object_samples
columns.description: Number of object samples in the image, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: has_at_least_one_object_sample_with_class_man
columns.description: set to 1 if the image has at least one object sample in the class of "man",otherwise, set to 0

columns.name: avg_height_of_objects
columns.description: Average height of the objects in the image

columns.name: num_self_relations
columns.description: the number of self-relations between the object samples in the image, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: has_at_least_five_black_classes
columns.description: set to 1 if the image has at least five object samples whose attribute class is 'black', otherwise, set to 0
